source_encoding_alias_note: L088 CMR/CMBX Gamma and LINE10 ascending stroke encode their outline at byte161 while the default extraction exposes TeX alias U+0000; both identity and page rendering were checked.
ligatures: Visible fi/fl ligatures become U+FB01/U+FB02. NFC preserves one glyph; NFKC expands them. No word editing.
composite_notation: Negation slash, similarity and equality, mapsto stroke and arrow, stacked delimiter pieces and diagram edge pieces stay separate. Extraction order and printed hyphens are retained.
whitespace_aliases: F014 CMEX right brace extracts as a tab; three large left parentheses extract as single spaces; one left angle bracket extracts as newline. These are bound to actual PDF visitor events; all synthesized whitespace is preserved.
not_claimed: A plain text stream does not preserve mathematical positioning, shape or graph incidence. This is not full visible-text or diagram reconstruction.
